sys_script_client.description:
HR Service: Harassment and Violence Disables the ability to see or upload attachments to a Harassment and Violence record if not authorized.
Groups allowed to see and attach documents to H&V cases are: Managers handling the case, Respectful Workplace group members and OHS admins.
sys_script_client.name: Hide attachments for H&V
